seoTitle: App of the Dead — Learn World Religions Free
metaDescription: Learn what 22 religions believe about the afterlife in 5-minute lessons. Gamified quizzes, daily streaks, and an Oracle that chats on your iPhone. Start free.
keywords: learn religion like a language app
heroHeadline: What happens after we die? Find out, one lesson at a time.
heroSubhead: App of the Dead turns comparative religion into a game. Bite-sized lessons, quick quizzes, and daily streaks take you across 22 traditions and the great afterlife myths of history. Neutral, respectful, and made for the curious.
highlights: The full Judaism path is free for life — no account, no time limit
22 traditions side by side, from Buddhism and Islam to Norse and Egyptian
Ask the Oracle: chat with deity guides through a model that runs on your iPhone

features.title: Every belief, side by side
features.body: Walk a path through Judaism, Christianity, Islam, Buddhism, Hinduism, Norse, Egyptian, Greek and more. See where the world's oldest answers agree and where they diverge.

features.title: Learn through play
features.body: Multiple-choice, matching, and true/false quizzes make Olam Ha-Ba, Valhalla, reincarnation, and the Duat stick. No dry textbook reading.

features.title: The Oracle
features.body: Chat with Anubis, Odin, Kali and other guides. After a one-time model download, the AI runs on your iPhone and your questions are answered on-device.

features.title: Built to keep you learning
features.body: Daily streaks turn five minutes into a habit. XP and levels track your progress, and badges mark each path you finish.

features.title: The Scroll of Ascension
features.body: Your profile becomes a living Book of the Dead: a golden XP ring, a Halls of the Dead trophy room for all 22 realms, and your full Hall of Honors.

features.title: Respectful by design
features.body: Every tradition is presented neutrally, with equal weight and no proselytizing. This is education, not conversion.

howItWorks.body: Open the Judaism path and learn Jewish afterlife beliefs and Olam Ha-Ba end to end, no account required.
Take a five-minute lesson a day, answer the quizzes, and watch your XP, levels, and badges climb.
Unlock the other 21 paths and unlimited Oracle conversations, or add single traditions whenever curiosity strikes.

faq.q: How much does App of the Dead cost?
faq.a: The full Judaism path is free forever, with no account and no time limit. Premium unlocks all 21 other paths and unlimited Oracle chat: $39.99/year (7-day free trial) or $9.99/month in the US.

faq.q: Is there a one-time purchase instead of a subscription?
faq.a: Yes. Ultimate Enlightenment is a one-time lifetime unlock if you would rather own everything outright. You can also buy individual belief systems one at a time.
Lessons and quizzes work offline once downloaded. The Oracle uses an on-device model, which is downloaded once over the internet; after that, your questions are answered on your iPhone.
Yes. After the model is downloaded, Oracle conversations are processed on-device, so your spiritual questions are answered on your phone rather than on a chat server.

faq.q: Is this trying to convert me to a religion?
faq.a: No. App of the Dead presents all 22 traditions neutrally and with equal respect. It is built for education and comparison, not conversion, and is not affiliated with any religious organization.
App of the Dead runs on iPhone and iPad with iOS 18.2 or later, in both light and dark mode.

faq.q: Is there a free trial for Premium?
faq.a: Yes. The annual plan includes a 7-day free trial. Subscriptions renew automatically through your Apple ID and can be cancelled anytime in Settings; any unused trial is forfeited once you purchase.

faq.q: Who is App of the Dead for?
faq.a: Religious-studies students, writers and worldbuilders researching afterlife lore, travelers, educators, and anyone curious about what different cultures believe comes next.
